text:
Elena K.: quick check — Solaris Health private rollout: staging nodes still can't pull container images after airgap prep. getting TLS/x509 errors. @Jonas L. any ideas? :wave:
Jonas L.: seeing this from the node logs: 
```
docker pull registry.redwood.internal/redwood/runtime:prod-7
Error response from daemon: Get "https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/": x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
looks like the mirror cert isn't trusted in the airgapped images. also firewall is rejecting outbound to our mirror IPs.
Matthew R.: for the mirror we need these CIDR blocks allowed out to our staging mirror (443/tcp):
```
198.51.100.0/24
203.0.113.128/25
```
and allow egress to these hostnames for apt/yum and container registry (SNI required):
- registry.redwood.internal
- mirrors.redwood-inference.com

Priya S.: confirm if KMS calls need external access. Solaris requested HSM integration; KMS calls are proxied via customer gateway but need 443 egress to kms.redwood-internal.svc for token exchange. if blocked, init fails.
Tina (ops): i'll take network owner here. opening infra ticket and scheduling a maintenance window this afternoon 15:00-15:30 PT. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4521 (will add the CIDRs and hostnames).
Elena K.: thanks Tina — can you also add the extra CA bundle step to the node bootstrap? current script doesn't install the mirror CA. snippet we run now: 
```
# bootstrap.sh (excerpt)
curl -fsSL https://bootstrap.redwood-inference.com/init.sh | bash
```
we should copy /opt/mirror/ca.pem into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and run `update-ca-certificates` during bootstrap.
Jonas L.: added a tiny change to infra repo, PR 4123 — installs CA and pins registry to mirror host. pinging @Matthew R. for firewall CIDR confirmation and @Priya S. for KMS proxy check. link: https://github.com/redwood-infra/airgap-bootstrap/pull/4123
Matthew R.: cidrs above are final from the mirror team. also need port 873 for rsync if they want bulk sync. adding note to INFRA-4521.
Priya S.: KMS proxy looks fine as long as customer gateway allows outbound 443 to `kms.redwood-internal.svc`. if not we can stub locally but that's last resort.
Tina (ops): change window scheduled. i'll coordinate with customer net team and run smoke tests: `curl -v https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/` and a `docker pull` from the node.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Tina (ops) for INFRA-4521 at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
Elena K.: quick ask — can someone do a fast review of PR 4123? small script changes but want to merge before the window. @Jonas L. @Matthew R.
Jonas L.: LGTM, left one nit about the `update-ca-certificates` path.
Matthew R.: reviewed, approve. added firewall note.
Elena K.: thanks all — i'll watch the window and report results here. if smoke passes we'll flip the staging flag and move to canary. :rocket:
Tina (ops): confirmed: after window, node can `docker pull` and apt repos sync. will post logs.
Elena K.: awesome — closing follow-up when customer sign-off received.
